name: Linked sessions
description: A reader for many related agent transcripts: each run's sessions as a tree, a lead with the subagents it started, on one clock above, and the chosen session's transcript at the center, its turns as a conversation with tool calls folded, where each subagent was started and where its result came back, and a subagent's transcript beside its parent's in the side panel.

records.name: call
records.one: one tool call, its tool_use line and its tool_result line

fields.name: time
fields.how: seconds since 1970 in UTC, from ISO 8601 with any offset or epoch milliseconds

fields.name: duration
fields.how: seconds between them

fields.name: kind
fields.how: call, beside a message's prompt, text and result

fields.name: tool
fields.how: Agent read as Task

fields.name: input
fields.how: as a line, its path, command, query or description, a Grep's pattern with its path and flags; whole, a Task's description and the prompt the subagent got, an Edit's file with the lines it took out and put in

fields.name: outcome
fields.from: is_error or isError, and the result's text
fields.how: denied when the text says so, error when flagged, else ok

fields.name: result
fields.how: its first line, a denial's or an error's prefix dropped

fields.name: exit
fields.how: the number after Exit code

fields.name: output
fields.how: the text as the record holds it, whole

fields.name: file type
fields.from: file_path, or a Bash command and its result
fields.how: the first path's extension, test files apart, none for a call with no file

fields.name: child
fields.from: the Task result's agentId, else the prompt a session got
fields.how: the session the Task call started

fields.name: run
fields.from: the folder the transcript is in
fields.how: the folder's name

fields.name: agent
fields.how: the agent whose transcript holds the call

fields.name: speaker
fields.how: the agent whose transcript holds the call

records.name: message
records.one: one prompt or text of a session

fields.name: time
fields.how: seconds since 1970 in UTC

fields.name: kind
fields.how: prompt, result for a session's last text, else text

fields.name: run
fields.from: the folder the transcript is in
fields.how: the folder's name

fields.name: agent
fields.how: the agent whose transcript holds the message

fields.name: speaker
fields.from: the session's agent and the session that spawned it
fields.how: for a prompt the agent that started the session, or user for a lead, else the session's agent

records.name: session
records.one: one transcript, a lead's or a subagent's

fields.name: agent
fields.from: a Task call's subagent_type, else the run's index
fields.how: the subagent's type, else the index's name, else lead

fields.name: parent
fields.from: the Task call that names its agentId or gave its prompt
fields.how: the session that started it

fields.name: depth
fields.how: sessions above it in its run's tree

fields.name: start
fields.how: seconds since 1970 in UTC

fields.name: end
fields.how: seconds since 1970 in UTC

accepts.means: the line <n>: a call (its tool_use or its tool_result line) or a message, its turn opened in its session's transcript, or in a run's index the run

units.means: one run: the view filtered to its sessions, its lead's transcript read
one session: its lane chosen and its transcript read
